mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 48 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 72.
The city has proposed the 2027 budget and the plan commission is set to review several development proposals on November 4th, including projects at Ardent Glen and Jenna Drive.
We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow, and various trivia nights starting later this week.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and please note the store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
